item.text:
“the stakes for our coverage has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our coverage have never been higher”
“the federal goverment's next steps” >>> “the federal government's next steps”
“matters more then ever” >>> “matters more than ever”
“has three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: Three cosponsors are claimed, but only two are named.]
“it's definitions are broad” >>> “its definitions are broad”
“its central principal” >>> “its central principle”
“In brief, the bill:” >>> “In brief:”
“the bill's enforcment regime” >>> “the bill's enforcement regime”
“would directly effect every company” >>> “would directly affect every company”
“Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield is identified as R-OH earlier.]
“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> “narrows the registry in Section 4”
“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: The bill summary gives a $1 million daily maximum; confirm the amount and whether the amendment changes it.]
“who's support may depend on it” >>> “whose support may depend on it”
“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”
“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee's 28 members”
“13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: These categories total 29, not the stated 28 members.]
“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow” >>> [CHECK: Only five are listed, versus six claimed. Kowalski and Ames are also described below as uncommitted; reconcile their classifications with the list and totals.]
“Thursday, October 14” >>> “Thursday, October 15”
“in a seperate interview” >>> “in a separate interview”
“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached”
“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”
“as soon as the week November 16” >>> “as soon as the week of November 16”
“hearing on the risks of advanced AI occured on September 30” >>> [CHECK: “Occured” should be “occurred”; confirm the hearing date, given the September 23 hearing referenced earlier.]
“would have to conclude within two years” >>> [CHECK: The Section 6 summary specifies 18 months, not two years; confirm the deadline and whether it requires negotiations to conclude.]
“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”
“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”
“reaching out to there senators” >>> “reaching out to their senators”
“you should recieve updated notes” >>> “you should receive updated notes”
“Each of our five Hill reporters” >>> [CHECK: The coverage plan previously says there are six Hill reporters; confirm the number or clarify that only five will file live-blog items.]
